principles: All 71 Production mapping features must have a source-family contract.
Only deterministic rule-bound facts from Production-authorized sources may auto-fill Production evidence_features.
TSL, JMA current-state shadow, same-day derived shadow and point-in-time population seed remain isolated from Production features unless separately promoted.
Existing request feature classifications are never silently overwritten.
Missing evidence remains missing. UNKNOWN is not WEAK and is not neutral 50.
Source-only readiness and request+source merged readiness are measured separately.
Per-index coverage and DCR resolvability are measured before Production base-index materialization.

weight_load_fit.condition: All active official JRA runners have the same assigned_weight.
weight_load_fit.rationale: Deterministic equal-load fact; no relative burden advantage is asserted.

shadow_sources.TSL: THIRD_PARTY_PUBLIC_SHADOW / RAW SIGNAL ONLY / NEVER AUTO-FILLS PRODUCTION
shadow_sources.JMA: OFFICIAL_CONTEXT_SHADOW / NO HORSE-SPECIFIC FIT WITHOUT HISTORY
shadow_sources.SAME_DAY_DERIVED: SHADOW UNTIL HORSE-STYLE MATCH RULE IS OOS-VALIDATED

zero_touch_claim_rule: ZERO-TOUCH SOURCE->20-INDEX may be claimed only when source_only_formal_base_ready=true for every runner and downstream FULL_REQUIRED materialization passes.
